name: Travel Destinations
overview: Compare destinations by season, interests and access.
practice: Check official travel advisories before booking.

name: Travel Budget
overview: Plan transport, nights, meals and contingency spending.
practice: Keep prices in one currency and include conversion fees.

name: Visa Information
overview: Understand common visa categories and application requirements.
practice: Use embassy or immigration authority information only.

name: Flights & Airports
overview: Learn fare classes, baggage rules and transit planning.
practice: Check ticket restrictions and passport validity.

name: Hotels & Stays
overview: Compare accommodation types, location and total fees.
practice: Review cancellation terms and property policies.

name: Local Transport
overview: Explore public transit, taxis and travel logistics.
practice: Verify regional ticket rules and service hours.

name: Travel Insurance
overview: Understand coverage, exclusions and claims conditions.
practice: Review pre-existing condition exclusions and policy wording.

name: Travel Packing
overview: Organize essentials based on climate and activities.
practice: Check airline restrictions for batteries and liquids.

name: Country Guides
overview: Learn practical orientation for selected destinations.
practice: Verify current entry, safety and transport conditions.

name: Trip Itinerary
overview: Plan realistic daily pacing and transfer buffers.
practice: Avoid over-scheduling and consider accessibility.

name: Cost of Living
overview: Compare recurring housing, food and mobility expenses.
practice: Use dated, location-specific information.

name: Moving Abroad
overview: Understand housing, documentation and settling-in steps.

overview: Compare cash flow, equity buildup and flexibility.

name: Mortgage Planning
overview: Understand down payments, terms and monthly obligations.
practice: Compare APR, fees and fixed-versus-variable terms.

name: Construction Cost
overview: Build estimates from materials, labor and quantities.
practice: Include waste, contingencies and permit costs.

name: Building Materials
overview: Compare specification, durability and cost trade-offs.
practice: Follow local structural and fire safety requirements.

name: Home Renovation
overview: Plan scope, budget and contractor sequencing.

name: Interior Design

name: Space Planning
overview: Understand circulation, storage and functional zones.

name: Home Utilities
overview: Review household electricity, water and connectivity costs.
practice: Compare local tariffs and usage patterns.

name: Home Maintenance
overview: Plan periodic inspections and repair budgets.
practice: Address hazards promptly with qualified services.

name: Kitchen & Appliances
overview: Compare appliance sizing, energy use and durability.
practice: Check safety certifications and available support.

name: Food & Restaurants
overview: Explore cuisine, food safety and dining budgets.

practice: Follow qualified veterinary guidance for medical needs.

name: Dog Care
overview: Explore exercise, behavior and everyday care considerations.
practice: Choose age-appropriate routines with professional input.

name: Cat Care
overview: Understand litter, play, enrichment and common care needs.
practice: Avoid unverified medical treatment claims.

name: Pet Budget
overview: Plan food, supplies, insurance and veterinary contingencies.

name: Consumer Buying Guides
overview: Learn comparison criteria across everyday products.
practice: Separate independent evaluation from sponsored placements.
